Name: Nyapu The Farmer's Children Compatibility Patch (Vanilla SVE RSV)
Author: SeaSea50
Description:
[center][/center][center][img]https://i.ibb.co/ZxMrNps/mod-details-1.png[/img]

This adds compatibility with the Vanilla, Stardew Valley Expanded and Ridgeside Village's spouses with matching hairstyles for The Farmer's Children mod.

If you want to use these hairstyles for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21412]Immersive Children[/url]﻿ mod you're in luck! I've released a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27513]separate patch[/url]﻿ which can be used with said mod ^-^

This is a replacer mod which means you will replace the hairstyle images located in the original mod

[s]Will I ever make matching sprites?? Probably, I'm just currently drained from finishing 500+ sprites so I'm good for now.

[/s]With version 2.0.0 there are now overworld sprites included!
 

[img]https://i.ibb.co/JtMTbjw/installation.png<img src=[/img]

This is a replacer mod - meaning it replaces the original mod's pngs. Here's a step by step guide on how to use this mod:

[list=1]
[*]Install the[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5436] The Farmer's Children[/url]﻿ Mod (the The Farmer's Children Art - Standard Art file)



[*]Make sure to download "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491?tab=files&file_id=108635]Nyapu's The Farmer's Children Art - Standard Art[/url]﻿" and follow the instructions on Nyapu's page - their mod includes the skin tones & clothing.




[*]Download and unzip this mod it has the same name as the original farmer's childrens mod '[NPC] The Farmer's Children Art - Standard'




[*]Drag and drop this mod over the original '[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5436?tab=files&file_id=106646][NPC] The Farmer's Children Art - Standard[/url]﻿' art




[*]You're done! This will add the new hairstyle options when checking the Farmer's Children config.
[/list][list=1]

[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/HtmBT4b/compatibility-1.png[/img][/url]

Portraits for Vanilla Spouses,[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753] Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]﻿


[img]https://i.ibb.co/y0bTYfR/credits.png[/img]
[/list]

Thank you xiddav for the incredible original mod - [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5436]The Farmer's Children[/url]﻿ - and thank you for the permission to release this patch ^-^

Thank you xiaoleiwen for the inspo for the style of hairs - and for the great immersive way to experience the Immersive Family mod and The Farmer's Children mod in one save! :>
